overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: task force members attending a Water Commissioners meeting did not deliberate, and the October 20, 2015 allegation was declined as untimely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a Board task force subcommittee deliberated outside a noticed meeting, based on members attending a Water Commissioners meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Participating in the type of open discussion that took place during the November 3, 2015 meeting does not constitute deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complaint also referenced a discussion on October 20, 2015, which was filed more than 90 days after the alleged violation.
allegations.key_passage: Because you requested review from our office after this date, and you did not demonstrate good cause for the delay, we decline to review this allegation.
